summary: Rank row/CSR data is split into GPU slices with rebased pointers. The timed OpenMP outlined worker statically assigns slices to threads, launches each assigned slice for every runtime iteration, then synchronizes and copies each slice's full output range. Worker loop bounds and launch calls were checked; final SASS traverses all CSR nonzeros per row and stores, with grid-stride row coverage.

source_evidence.claim: MPI rank data, GPU slice setup/rebasing, timed per-slice repetition and output copies/gather.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed region calls outlined worker; worker assigns slices, iterates the runtime count around kernel stub launches, synchronizes and copies outputs.
